+ 
+ // The id for the main config row (can be 'main' or 1, depending on your table setup)
+ const SITE_CONFIG_ID = 'main';
+ 
+ export type SiteMode = 'normal' | 'unavailable' | 'update' | 'development';
+ 
+ export async function fetchSiteMode(): Promise<SiteMode> {
+   const { data, error } = await supabase
+     .from('site_config')
+     .select('mode')
+     .eq('id', SITE_CONFIG_ID)
+     .single();
+   if (error || !data) return 'normal'; // fallback
+   return data.mode as SiteMode;
+ }
+ 
+ export async function updateSiteMode(mode: SiteMode): Promise<boolean> {
+   const { error } = await supabase
+     .from('site_config')
+     .update({ mode })
+     .eq('id', SITE_CONFIG_ID);
+   return !error;
+ }
